name: How long does a typical laundry room cabinet installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical laundry room cabinet installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a laundry room cabinet installation varies depending on the project's scope, including the number of cabinets, custom features, and any necessary wall preparation. A straightforward installation might take one to two days, while more complex projects involving custom designs or additional modifications could extend to several days. We provide a detailed project timeline after an initial consultation and site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from one to two days for simple projects to several days for complex ones, depending on scope and custom features.
